diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~46% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.392), which favours a weighted combination.
